about_the_game:
This digital art book contains behind the scenes looks at the development of the BAFTA-nominated critical hit Vampire Therapist, including characters, environments, and gameplay elements. You’ll see how our characters grew and changed during development, from the first sketches to their final implementations. Includes never before seen imagery from both Vampire Therapist and its DLC, Couples Therapy.

Set foot into our goth club Immernacht and its near environs in Leipzig, Germany, replete with the spooky and the sexy.

Can you count the bats in our interfaces? There sure are a lot! You’ll also see how we developed our visual language.

Anecdotes from the game’s development are on every page, so you won’t miss a thing!
